description: A terminal window is open in the Muncie HEC-RAS project directory. The project contains completed simulation results in an HDF5 file. Python analysis scripts are available in the ~/Documents/analysis_scripts/ directory. Your task is to extract peak water surface elevation (WSE) data from the simulation results. Find the appropriate analysis script, determine how to use it (check its --help output or read the script to understand its arguments), and run it against the simulation results HDF5 file. Save the output as a CSV file in ~/Documents/hec_ras_results/. The analysis should report the overall peak WSE, mean peak WSE across all computational cells, and per-cell peak values.
